# Where to Watch All Who Are Weary


by Angel | November 19, 2026


What happens when the life you’ve built leaves you feeling more broken than ever? For three men in the heavy metal music world, the search for relief leads them down very different paths—but each eventually reaches a point where something has to change.


*All Who Are Weary* is a powerful documentary about addiction, despair, and the life-changing hope of Jesus Christ. Through the honest stories of these three musicians, it shows that no one is beyond the reach of God’s love.


[Watch All Who Are Weary now on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/all-who-are-weary)


### **Three Lives Reaching a Breaking Point**


From the outside, Korn guitarist Brian “Head” Welch, metalhead Doug Nadin, and Jimmy Ray Brown Jr., vocalist for Dose of Adolescence, seem to have found their place in the heavy metal world. But behind the music, each is carrying a heavy burden.


Brian Welch struggles with daily crystal meth use. Doug Nadin finds himself drawn into increasingly dark music and drug use. And Jimmy Ray Brown Jr. carries the pain of a difficult childhood and a future he never thought he’d have.


Their stories reveal just how much pain can hide beneath the surface—and how difficult it can be to find a way forward when life feels hopeless.


### **Stories of Faith and Redemption**


At its heart, *All Who Are Weary* is about the power of transformation. Brian, Doug, and Jimmy each have a different story, but their experiences point to the same truth: no matter how far someone has fallen, change is possible.


The documentary also shows how their choices affect the people around them, including their families. Angel Guild members have praised the film for its honest testimonies and powerful message of hope, with one viewer calling it an “amazing life-giving documentary.”


### **A Message for Anyone Who Needs Hope**


You don’t have to be part of the heavy metal world to connect with these stories. The struggles these men face—pain, addiction, loneliness, and the search for purpose—are deeply human. Their experiences offer a reminder that no one is too far gone for God’s grace, and that true rest can be found in Christ.


Whether you’re familiar with their music or hearing their stories for the first time, *All Who Are Weary* offers a moving look at what can happen when people discover a hope greater than their past.


### **Watch** ***All Who Are Weary*** **on Angel**


Three men. Three different paths. One life-changing discovery. See how Brian “Head” Welch, Doug Nadin, and Jimmy Ray Brown Jr. found hope beyond addiction and despair in *All Who Are Weary* .
